entities.summary: Michel Jalakh O.A.M. is a Lebanese Maronite Catholic archbishop and Roman Curia official. He has served as Secretary of the Dicastery for the Eastern Churches since February 2023. He was appointed Titular Archbishop of Nisibi of the Maronites in March 2024. He is a member of the Antonian Maronite Order and has held numerous academic and ecumenical leadership roles, including Rector of the Antonian University in Baabda and Secretary General of the Middle East Council of Churches (MECC).
